trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بَطْشُهٗ شَدِيْدٌ وَعَفْوُهٗ قَدِيْمٌ وَمُلْكُهٗ مُسْتَقِيْمٌ وَلُطْفُهٗ شَدِيْدٌ يَا مَنْ سَتَرَ عَلَيَّ الْقَبِيْحَ وَظَهَرَ بِالْجَمِيْلِ وَلَمْ يُعَجِّلْ بِالْعُقُوْبَةِ وَيَا مَنْ اَذِنَ لِلْعِبَادِ بِالتَّوْبَةِ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَهْتِكِ السِّتْرَ لَدَى (لِذِي‌) الْفَضِيْحَةِ يَا مَنْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ غَدٍ غَيْرُهٗ (وَ) يَا جَابِرَ كُلِّ كَسِيْرٍ يَا مَاوٰى كُلِّ هَارِبٍ يَا غَاذِيَ مَا فِيْ بُطُوْنِ الْاُمَّهَاتِ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA YAA MAN BAT-SHO-HU SHADEE-DOON WA A’FWO-HU QADEE-MOON WA MULKO-HU MUSTA-QEE-MOON WA LUTFO-HU SHADEE-DOON YAA MAN SATARA A’LAIY-YAL QABEE-HA WA ZAHARA BIL JAMEE-LE WA LAM YO-A’JJIL BIL-O’QOO-BATE WA YAA MAN AZE-NA LIL-E’BAADE BIT-TAWBA-TE YAA MAN LAM YAHTE-KIS SITRA LADAL (LEZIL) FAZEE-HATE YAA MAN LAA YA’LAMO MAA FEE GHA-DIN GHAIRO-HU (WA) YAA JAABE-RA KULLE KASEE-RIN YAA MAAWAA KULLE HAARE-BIN YAA GHAAZE-YA MAA FEE BOTOO-NIL UMMA-HAATE.

trans.en: O my God! O He whose Assault is Mighty, whose Forgiveness is Eternal, whose Authority is Firm, and whose Kindness is great! O He who covers up my awful deeds and reveals beautiful deeds! He does not rush to punish! O He who permitted Your servants to repent! O He who does not divulge secrets of scandals! O He other than whom no one knows what is in the future! O He who mends all that is broken! O He who is the Shelter of all who flee! O He who feeds what is in the wombs of mothers!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: يَا سَيِّدِيْ اَنْتَ لِيْ فِيْ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ نَزَلَتْ بِيْ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاكْفِنِيْ مَا اَهَمَّنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الْوَاسِعِ رِزْقًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ (اسْتَغَثْتُ) فُكَّ اَسْرِيْ وَاَصْلِحْ لِيْ شَانِيْ كُلَّهٗ وَلَا تَكِلْنِيْ اِلٰى نَفْسِيْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ اَبَدًا مَا اَبْقَيْتَنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA SAYYADI ANTA LEE FEE KULLE HAA-JATIN NAZA-LAT BEE SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WAK-FENEE MAA A-HAMMA-NEE WAR-ZUQNEE MIN RIZQE-KAL WAASE-E’ RIZQAN HALAA-LAN TAIYYE-BAN YAA HAIYYO YAA QAIYYOO-MO BE-RAH-MATEKA ASTA-GHEESO (ASTA-GHAS-TO) FUKKA ASREE WA ASLEH LEE SHAA-NEE KULLA-HU WA LAA TAKIL-NEE ILAA NAFSEE TAR-FATA A’IYNIN ABA-DAN MAA AB-QAIY-TANEE BE-RAH-MATEKA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O my Master! You are He who fulfills all my needs that come up. Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s). Please take care of my affairs and bless me with Your Abundant, Pure and Legitimate Sustenance. O the Living! O the Eternal! I seek help from Your Mercy. So please release me from slavery. Please improve all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the twinkling of an eye for as long as I live by Your Mercy O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
